explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance fault. Job 2 consumed evidence_sources whose record_id values are source IDs (s01...s08), while the downstream needs and coverage records use demand record IDs (n06-r01...n06-r08). This prevents prioritize from matching upstream ranks, producing upstream_rank 0 for every priority row. The visible source of assemble_provenance constructs evidence rows with record_id set to record.get('source_id'), so the fault localizes to job_1 assemble_provenance.
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record identity with the source identity.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while Job 2 input needs contains record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for all eight records, consistent with failed rank lookup by demand record_id.
